## Summary
Provides congestion-control helper utilities for probing available bandwidth and detecting trends in sampled values. The package owns probe cluster scheduling, probe regulation after congestion signals, probe signal enums, and generic trend detection based on sample windows.

## Responsibilities
- Manage probe clusters that send padding probes at controlled rates and durations.
- Regulate when probing can resume and how long probes should run after congestion signals.
- Represent probe and trend state enums with stable string output.
- Track numeric sample windows and infer upward, downward, or inconclusive trends.
